results.title: A state change without the app's Origin, or from another origin, is refused 403
results.detail: The case omits or forges the Origin header; apiRequest cannot set request headers. The step format needs a headers option, under the allowlist.

results.title: A state change with a text/plain body is refused 415
results.detail: The case sends a text/plain body; apiRequest cannot set the content type. The step format needs a content-type option.

results.title: Malformed JSON answers 400 with the error contract, never 500
results.detail: The case sends a malformed JSON body; apiRequest bodies are JSON objects and cannot be malformed. The step format needs a raw-body option.
